_about: reFuzz config schema v2 (PROPOSAL). Clean re-layout of the v1 keys parsed by control/config_parser + control/startup/json_frontend. Goals: group by concept, unit-suffixed names, uniform across backends, dead keys removed. Any key starting with '_' is a comment and is ignored by the parser. This file is the KERNEL (qemu_ivshmem_linux) reference with every knob at its code default; real configs set only what they override.

target._comment: execution semantics. WAS a flat 19-key block; now grouped into modes/capabilities/threading/debug.

modes._comment: surface = WAS modes.execution; renamed so it doesn't collide with target.execution below. surface = what ABI/surface is driven: kernel_syscall | userspace_harness | binary_dbi.

execution._comment: how the worker runs each program. 'mode' = scheduling strategy (serial|threaded). 'snapshot' is an ORTHOGONAL toggle (per-testcase VM reset) that combines with EITHER mode. WAS target.threading.intra_task_mode + qemu.snapshot_fuzzing.

threaded._comment: config for mode=threaded; ignored when mode=serial. mode=threaded requires thread_count>1.

snapshot._comment: orthogonal to mode: per-testcase VM savevm/loadvm reset (replaces v1 qemu.snapshot_fuzzing; resolver auto-selects the snapshot backend). enable=true works with serial OR threaded.

debug._comment: diagnostics; all off in production. WAS debug_smaps / debug_empty_fork / ... (debug_ prefix dropped).

session._comment: this run's workspace + stop condition (merged session + run). work_dir='' -> /tmp. state_dir='' -> <work_dir>/state. keep_runs = newest run-*/ dirs kept at startup (older pruned by mtime, 0 = keep all); state/ (corpus/coverage/repros) never touched. WAS v1 retention/retention_max + phase1_run_limit_mode/phase1_runtime_seconds/phase1_total_tasks.

fuzzer._comment: the fuzz loop. corpus moved out to its own top-level 'corpus' module.

executor._comment: dispatch module (channeldispatcher). Owns its loop tuning AND the channel it drives, so 'channel' is nested here. Flattened tuning: WAS submit_strategy.name / event_forward_strategy.blocking_timeout_ms / timeouts_ms.{poll,pop}; legacy aliases dropped.

channel._comment: the SUT substrate + transport + liveness. backend_id selects which backend parser owns the 'backend' sub-block.

backend._comment: backend-specific launch+wire config. Shape depends on channel.backend_id. THIS block = qemu_ivshmem_linux. (xiuos/ch32 shapes shown in the chat message.)

qemu._comment: snapshot here = disk CoW overlay (-snapshot); NOT the snapshot execution mode (that moved to target.execution.mode=snapshot).

corpus._comment: standalone corpus module. Absorbs v1 fuzzer.corpus (capacity/max_drain) + persistence.corpus + persistence.crash_repros_as_seeds. The corpus owns its own persistence toggle.

coverage._comment: coverage module owns its own persistence toggle (was the inverted persistence.coverage). DEAD keys removed: kcov.drain_seconds / persist_seconds / max_inbox_batches.

persistence._comment: save/load the coverage.bin state across runs.

export._comment: optional 10-second coverage metric logs for compare tooling.

telemetry._comment: host-side observability. logging lives HERE for all backends now (v1 xiuos read top-level 'logging').

wiring._comment: OPTIONAL component-graph wiring (parsed by control/startup/json_frontend). Omit the whole block to use the profile's defaults (shown here for 'kernel'). feedback_engine here REPLACES the v1 top-level feedback_engine_spec and overrides components.feedback_engine.
